CREATE TABLE hamtdaa_billing_orders (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  command_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  plan TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(plan IN ('monthly','yearly')),
  duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(duration_seconds IN (2592000,31536000)),
  amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_minor IN (990000,7990000)),
  currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MNT' CHECK(currency='MNT'),
  livemode INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(livemode IN (0,1)),
  return_url TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  provider_id TEXT UNIQUE,
  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'reserved' CHECK(state IN ('reserved','new','requires_payment_method','requires_action','requires_capture','processing','succeeded','canceled','refunded')),
  checkout_url TEXT,
  next_action TEXT CHECK(next_action IS NULL OR json_valid(next_action)),
  expires_at INTEGER,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(user_id,command_id),
  CHECK((plan='monthly' AND duration_seconds=2592000 AND amount_minor=990000)
    OR (plan='yearly' AND duration_seconds=31536000 AND amount_minor=7990000))
)

objects.name: hamtdaa_memories
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE hamtdaa_memories (
  id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK(
    length(id)=36 AND substr(id,9,1)='-' AND substr(id,14,1)='-'
    AND substr(id,19,1)='-' AND substr(id,24,1)='-'
    AND length(replace(id,'-',''))=32
    AND replace(id,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  ),
  pair_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES hamtdaa_pairs(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  creator_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES hamtdaa_profiles(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  day TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(
    day GLOB '20[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'
    AND date(day,'+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(day,'+0 days')=day
  ),
  title TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80),
  note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK(length(note)<=2000),
  sticker TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(sticker IN ('rounded','polaroid')),
  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(state IN ('pending','ready')),
  photo_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(photo_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 512),
  thumbnail_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(thumbnail_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 512),
  photo_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(photo_bytes)='integer' AND photo_bytes>0),
  thumb_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(thumb_bytes)='integer' AND thumb_bytes>0),
  payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload_hash)=64 AND payload_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  command_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(command_id)=36),
  version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(typeof(version)='integer' AND version>0),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(created_at)='integer' AND created_at>0),
  upload_deadline INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(upload_deadline)='integer' AND upload_deadline>created_at),
  UNIQUE(creator_id,command_id),
  CHECK(photo_key<>thumbnail_key)
)

  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK(state IN ('open','awaiting_creator','linked','revoked','declined','cancelled','expired')),

  CHECK(state NOT IN ('awaiting_creator','linked') OR (requester_id IS NOT NULL AND requested_at IS NOT NULL)),
  CHECK(state <> 'linked' OR (pair_id IS NOT NULL AND confirmed_at IS NOT NULL))
)

objects.name: hamtdaa_billing_grant_owner_immutable
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER hamtdaa_billing_grant_owner_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON hamtdaa_billing_grants
WHEN NEW.user_id<>OLD.user_id OR NEW.provider<>OLD.provider OR NEW.source_id<>OLD.source_id OR NEW.environment<>OLD.environment
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'billing_grant_owner_immutable'); END

objects.name: hamtdaa_billing_order_immutable
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER hamtdaa_billing_order_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON hamtdaa_billing_orders
WHEN NEW.user_id<>OLD.user_id OR NEW.command_id<>OLD.command_id OR NEW.plan<>OLD.plan
  OR NEW.duration_seconds<>OLD.duration_seconds OR NEW.amount_minor<>OLD.amount_minor
  OR NEW.currency<>OLD.currency OR NEW.livemode<>OLD.livemode
  OR NEW.return_url<>OLD.return_url OR NEW.description<>OLD.description
  OR NEW.created_at<>OLD.created_at
  OR (OLD.provider_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.provider_id IS NOT OLD.provider_id)
  OR (OLD.checkout_url IS NOT NULL AND NEW.checkout_url IS NOT OLD.checkout_url
    AND NOT (NEW.checkout_url IS NULL AND EXISTS(
      SELECT 1 FROM hamtdaa_deleted_accounts WHERE user_id=NEW.user_id)))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'billing_order_immutable'); END

objects.name: hamtdaa_deleted_grant_insert
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER hamtdaa_deleted_grant_insert AFTER INSERT ON hamtdaa_billing_grants
WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hamtdaa_deleted_accounts WHERE user_id=NEW.user_id)
  AND (NEW.refresh_cipher IS NOT NULL OR NEW.is_active<>0)
BEGIN UPDATE hamtdaa_billing_grants SET refresh_cipher=NULL,is_active=0
  WHERE provider=NEW.provider AND source_id=NEW.source_id; END

objects.name: hamtdaa_deleted_grant_update
objects.sql:

hamtdaa_memory_delete_gc

CREATE TRIGGER hamtdaa_memory_delete_gc BEFORE DELETE ON hamtdaa_memories
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO hamtdaa_memory_gc(object_key,due_at,retain_until)
    VALUES(OLD.photo_key,CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000+300000,
      CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000+86400000)
    ON CONFLICT(object_key) DO UPDATE SET
      due_at=max(hamtdaa_memory_gc.due_at,excluded.due_at),
      retain_until=max(hamtdaa_memory_gc.retain_until,excluded.retain_until);
  INSERT INTO hamtdaa_memory_gc(object_key,due_at,retain_until)
    VALUES(OLD.thumbnail_key,CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000+300000,
      CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000+86400000)
    ON CONFLICT(object_key) DO UPDATE SET
      due_at=max(hamtdaa_memory_gc.due_at,excluded.due_at),
      retain_until=max(hamtdaa_memory_gc.retain_until,excluded.retain_until);
END

objects.name: hamtdaa_memory_immutable
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER hamtdaa_memory_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON hamtdaa_memories
WHEN OLD.state<>'pending' OR NEW.state<>'ready'
  OR NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.pair_id IS NOT OLD.pair_id
  OR NEW.creator_id IS NOT OLD.creator_id OR NEW.day IS NOT OLD.day
  OR NEW.title IS NOT OLD.title OR NEW.note IS NOT OLD.note
  OR NEW.sticker IS NOT OLD.sticker OR NEW.photo_key IS NOT OLD.photo_key
  OR NEW.thumbnail_key IS NOT OLD.thumbnail_key OR NEW.photo_bytes IS NOT OLD.photo_bytes
  OR NEW.thumb_bytes IS NOT OLD.thumb_bytes OR NEW.payload_hash IS NOT OLD.payload_hash
  OR NEW.command_id IS NOT OLD.command_id OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at
  OR NEW.upload_deadline IS NOT OLD.upload_deadline
  OR NEW.version NOT IN (OLD.version,OLD.version+1)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'memory_immutable'); END

objects.name: hamtdaa_memory_insert_guard
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER hamtdaa_memory_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON hamtdaa_memories
WHEN NEW.state<>'pending' OR NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM hamtdaa_pairs p
  JOIN hamtdaa_pair_members own ON own.pair_id=p.id
    AND own.user_id=NEW.creator_id AND own.revoked_at IS NULL
  JOIN hamtdaa_pair_members other ON other.pair_id=p.id
    AND other.user_id<>own.user_id AND other.revoked_at IS NULL
  JOIN hamtdaa_profiles ap ON ap.user_id=own.user_id AND ap.account_state='active'
  JOIN hamtdaa_profiles op ON op.user_id=other.user_id AND op.account_state='active'
  JOIN "user" au ON au.id=own.user_id AND au.emailVerified=1
  JOIN "user" ou ON ou.id=other.user_id AND ou.emailVerified=1
  WHERE p.id=NEW.pair_id AND p.state='active'
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hamtdaa_deleted_accounts d
      WHERE d.user_id IN (own.user_id,other.user_id))
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hamtdaa_blocks b
      WHERE (b.blocker_id=own.user_id AND b.blocked_id=other.user_id)
         OR (b.blocker_id=other.user_id AND b.blocked_id=own.user_id))
)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'memory_pair_guard'); END

objects.name: hamtdaa_memory_key_guard

CREATE TRIGGER hamtdaa_memory_key_guard BEFORE INSERT ON hamtdaa_memories
WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hamtdaa_memories m
    WHERE m.photo_key IN (NEW.photo_key,NEW.thumbnail_key)
       OR m.thumbnail_key IN (NEW.photo_key,NEW.thumbnail_key))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hamtdaa_memory_gc g
    WHERE g.object_key IN (NEW.photo_key,NEW.thumbnail_key))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'memory_object_key_used'); END

BEGIN

END

objects.name: hamtdaa_memory_ready_guard
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER hamtdaa_memory_ready_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF state ON hamtdaa_memories
WHEN NEW.state='ready' AND (
  NEW.upload_deadline<=CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000
  OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM hamtdaa_pairs p
    JOIN hamtdaa_pair_members own ON own.pair_id=p.id
      AND own.user_id=NEW.creator_id AND own.revoked_at IS NULL
    JOIN hamtdaa_pair_members other ON other.pair_id=p.id
      AND other.user_id<>own.user_id AND other.revoked_at IS NULL
    JOIN hamtdaa_profiles ap ON ap.user_id=own.user_id AND ap.account_state='active'
    JOIN hamtdaa_profiles op ON op.user_id=other.user_id AND op.account_state='active'
    JOIN "user" au ON au.id=own.user_id AND au.emailVerified=1
    JOIN "user" ou ON ou.id=other.user_id AND ou.emailVerified=1
    WHERE p.id=NEW.pair_id AND p.state='active'
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hamtdaa_deleted_accounts d
        WHERE d.user_id IN (own.user_id,other.user_id))
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hamtdaa_blocks b
        WHERE (b.blocker_id=own.user_id AND b.blocked_id=other.user_id)
           OR (b.blocker_id=other.user_id AND b.blocked_id=own.user_id))
  )
)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'memory_pair_guard'); END

objects.name: hamtdaa_pair_activate_guard

CREATE TRIGGER hamtdaa_pair_activate_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF state ON hamtdaa_pairs
WHEN NEW.state='active' AND (OLD.state<>'forming' OR (
    SELECT count(*) FROM hamtdaa_pair_members WHERE pair_id=NEW.id AND revoked_at IS NULL
  )<>2)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'pair_activation_guard');
END

objects.name: hamtdaa_pair_member_insert_guard

CREATE TRIGGER hamtdaa_pair_member_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON hamtdaa_pair_members
WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM hamtdaa_pairs p JOIN hamtdaa_pair_invitations i ON i.id=p.invitation_id
    JOIN hamtdaa_profiles u ON u.user_id=NEW.user_id JOIN "user" a ON a.id=u.user_id
    WHERE p.id=NEW.pair_id AND p.state='forming' AND u.account_state='active' AND a.emailVerified=1
      AND i.state='awaiting_creator' AND i.expires_at>CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)
      AND ((NEW.slot=1 AND NEW.user_id=i.creator_id) OR (NEW.slot=2 AND NEW.user_id=i.requester_id))
  )
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'pair_membership_guard');
END

CREATE TRIGGER hamtdaa_wish_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON hamtdaa_wishes

  SELECT 1 FROM hamtdaa_pairs p
  JOIN hamtdaa_pair_members own ON own.pair_id=p.id AND own.user_id=NEW.creator_id AND own.revoked_at IS NULL
  JOIN hamtdaa_pair_members other ON other.pair_id=p.id AND other.user_id<>own.user_id AND other.revoked_at IS NULL
  JOIN hamtdaa_profiles ap ON ap.user_id=own.user_id AND ap.account_state='active'
  JOIN hamtdaa_profiles op ON op.user_id=other.user_id AND op.account_state='active'
  JOIN "user" au ON au.id=own.user_id AND au.emailVerified=1
  JOIN "user" ou ON ou.id=other.user_id AND ou.emailVerified=1
  WHERE p.id=NEW.pair_id AND p.state='active'
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hamtdaa_deleted_accounts d WHERE d.user_id IN (own.user_id,other.user_id))
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hamtdaa_blocks b WHERE (b.blocker_id=own.user_id AND b.blocked_id=other.user_id) OR (b.blocker_id=other.user_id AND b.blocked_id=own.user_id))
)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'wish_pair_guard'); END
